title: ZTAS-DTh: code and data for a zero-trust security architecture for the digital thread (v1.3.0)
description:
Code, configurations, random seeds, raw and processed data, executed notebooks, bounded model-checking logs, a single-host software proof of concept and its test results accompanying the manuscript ZTAS-DTh: A Lifecycle-Spanning Zero-Trust Security Architecture for the Digital Thread — Design, Bounded Formal Analysis, and Simulation-Based Evaluation.

v1.3.0 adds the fourth-revision package (revision_v1.3.0/ZTAS-DTh_v1.3.0_revision_package.zip, SHA-256 332b1783583f4335b94512eefeb232ab4f72966ba30a16b745952134ea79df98), which contains everything in v1.2.0 plus all analyses reported in manuscript revisions v5–v7: alternate parameter ranges and surrogate validation; missing telemetry as a signal; monitoring step-up rate; graded responses; TLA+ transcriptions of models M1, M4f, M4g, M5a and M5b checked with TLC; proof-of-concept tests T-L to T-N and an extended T-J; effect sizes and simultaneous confidence intervals; a cryptographic re-run; a 23 factorial ablation (216,000 simulations) with main effects, interactions and order dependence of attribution; a zones-with-monitoring baseline-fairness check; topology statistics; distributed-enforcement models M5a–b (40 bounded checks in total); risk-engine weight perturbation and manipulated and stale telemetry; an E1 fidelity check; post-quantum key and signature sizes and per-record provenance overhead; the revised manuscript (v7), supplementary material, response to reviewers, audit reports and a SHA-256 manifest of every file. Archived scripts changed since v1.2.0 were changed additively; re-runs reproduce the v1.2.0 E1 results exactly on the same seeds.

Scope: all control-effectiveness probabilities are modelling assumptions, all risk-score distributions are synthetic, benchmarks were measured on a shared server VM, and no industrial measurement or deployment is included.
